analysis:
The only changed file is CHANGELOG.md, a documentation-only file with no executable code, config, or protocol changes. The supplied units are BASE text of lines 1-332 (the v0.10.6 candidate section). The patch excerpt shows the head rewrites the heading to v0.10.7 and adds about 400 lines of release notes, but the head text is not supplied and the patch excerpt is truncated. I could verify only what the excerpt shows, which is the v0.10.7 rollout notes. These say that both Macs of a pair must run the same 0.10.7 build, that mismatched builds fail closed, and that Gemma 4 and MiMo tensor parallel become declared in ClusterPublicModels and in the release cluster-runtime facts.

Security relevance: these are statements about cluster pairing, attestation-adjacent release facts and public-model declarations. They touch TB-011 and TB-002 conceptually, but the changelog itself changes no controls. The base text includes statements about per-tenant prefix-cache scoping, a digest of the scope, encrypted SSD tiers and the pairing-keyed encrypted link. These are consistent with the existing T-041 posture (HMAC lookup tags, scope folded into the tag, TTL). The base section also notes that the SSD checkpoints' namespace is bound to the binary hash. I found no claim that weakens the T-041 TTL or isolation guarantees, and no new secrets exposed.

Remaining integration questions: the actual code for #1702, #1706, #1707, #1715, #1723, #1727 and #1736 is not in this batch. The changelog claims, namely the public declaration of Gemma/MiMo tensor parallel, the coordinated pair self-update, and the changed Qwen TP control wire, need review in their source files. In particular, the pair update and public-model grants need review for authorization and attestation implications, but no concrete regression is evidenced here. No findings are raised on a documentation-only change.
